title: A/B Exposure Quotas & Risk-Gated Rollout Framework for Model Versions
creator: Miguel Santos
description: Implement a first-class A/B testing framework for model versions that combines exposure control, sequential statistical checks, and automated rollback gates. This ticket defines the product requirements, success criteria, and high-level rollout plan for a new experiment primitive in the Console and API. Goals: enable safe incremental exposure (canary -> ramp), support shadow traffic experiments, provide configurable statistical checks (Type I control, minimum detectable effect, power), and wire automatic rollback triggers based on user-defined and platform-suggested metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Console: new Experiment creation flow that allows selecting baseline and candidate model versions, allocation rules (percent, segment), and shadow mode toggle.
API: REST endpoint to create/manage experiments with exposure_quota, max_exposure_per_minute, and rollback_policy fields.
Safety gates: default statistical checks (p-value threshold, sequential monitoring via alpha-spending) and platform-recommended thresholds are applied unless overridden.
Rollback: automatic rollback is triggered when configured alert conditions persist for the configured evaluation window; rollback executes an atomic routing change restoring baseline traffic.

Observability: experiment dashboard displays cumulative exposure, conversion metrics, confidence intervals, sequential p-values, and time-to-detectability estimates; integrates with existing cost/latency breakdowns.
Shadow traffic: experiments can be run in shadow mode where candidate receives mirrored requests without user-facing exposure and with separate quota accounting.
Docs & runbook: public Console help and an internal runbook describing investigation steps for false positives and manual override procedures.
engineering_notes: Backend: extend routing API to accept experiment_id and enforce exposure_quota atomically across route proxies.
Runtime: KV cache warmup required for candidate model instances when ramping from 0% to >1% exposure to avoid cold-start regressions.
Metrics: add experiment_id tag to all generated metrics (latency, token_count, top-level outcome labels) with cardinality guardrails.
Stat tests: integrate sequential testing library (alpha-spending / Pocock) and provide bootstrap-based confidence intervals for non-Gaussian metrics.
Storage: store experiment config, checkpoints, and decisions in the control-plane DB with audit trail for compliance.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal dogfood in staging with synthetic traffic mirrors; validate metric tagging and dashboarding (2 wks).
Phase 1: Canary at 0.5% exposure for low-risk customers with manual guardrails (1 wk).
Phase 2: Gradual ramp using exposure_quota with automatic statistical checks (up to 10% over 2 wks).
Phase 3: Large-scale A/B for evaluation against business KPIs (up to 50%) with sales/customer opt-in.
Fallback: automatic rollback on sustained metric regression or manual rollback via Console immediate action.
